purpose: Proves the merged animation toolkit (tools/character_animation/ForensicWard_Animation_Pipeline_v03) runs on the owner's Mac with Blender 5.2.2 and that its clips export to GLB and play in Godot 4.7.2. The cloud thread's v04 build (claude/naomi-animation-v04) is the animation candidate; this file does not compete with it.
built_on: Owner's Mac (Apple Silicon), Blender 5.2.2 LTS, MPFB2 extension present (build 20261010) but not used: no MPFB asset packs are installed locally and the v03 game_engine rig has no face bones for MPFB expressions

inputs.used: Unchanged mesh, materials, skin weights and 53-bone rig; provenance in naomi_character_manifest_v03.json

known_limitations: Validation-strength motion only: one to three degrees on two bones per clip. Not final acting.
No blink, expressions or mouth shapes: v03 has no shape keys.
Not added to CharacterVisualPreview; captures used a temporary local edit that was reverted.
Blender warns that some vertices have more than 4 joint influences; glTF keeps the 4 strongest (same as v03).
Godot imports clips without loop mode; the acting adapter must set looping.
